question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_a_patients AS (
  SELECT patient.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` patient
  WHERE (patient.deceased IS NULL OR patient.deceased.boolean IS NOT TRUE)
    AND (SELECT family FROM UNNEST(patient.name) WHERE use = 'official' LIMIT 1) LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_condition_counts AS (
  SELECT lap.patient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_conditions
  FROM living_a_patients lap
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON lap.patient_id = c.subject.patientId
  GROUP BY lap.patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT pcc.patient_id, c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM patient_condition_counts pcc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON pcc.patient_id = c.subject.patientId
),
patient_condition_meds AS (
  SELECT scp.patient_id, scp.condition_code, scp.condition_display,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mr.id) as num_active_meds
  FROM single_condition_patients scp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
    ON scp.patient_id = mr.subject.patientId
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY scp.patient_id, scp.condition_code, scp.condition_display
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT condition_code, condition_display,
         MAX(num_active_meds) as max_meds_per_patient
  FROM patient_condition_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT condition_display, condition_code, max_meds_per_patient
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_meds_per_patient DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
